factual_claims.claim: SAF Tehnika’s consolidated turnover for the 2024/2025 financial year was EUR 26.11 million, down 4% from EUR 27.09 million in 2023/2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: For the 12 months of the 2024/2025 financial year, the Group’s unaudited consolidated turnover was EUR 26.11 million, a 4% decline from the previous financial year’s revenue.

factual_claims.claim: Despite the lower revenue, the Group significantly reduced its annual net loss to EUR 820 thousand from EUR 2.37 million, while EBIT improved to a loss of EUR 754 thousand from a loss of EUR 2.26 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: The consolidated unaudited result for the twelve months of the 2024/2025 financial year is a loss of EUR 820 thousand. The Group reported a loss of EUR 2.37 million for the 2023/2024 financial year. EBIT for 2024/2025 was (EUR 754 thousand) vs (EUR 2.26 million) in 2023/2024.

factual_claims.claim: The improvement was supported by lower direct costs of goods sold, which declined to EUR 9.33 million from EUR 13.12 million, and lower total operating expenses of EUR 27.56 million compared with EUR 30.27 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Direct cost of goods sold or services rendered: (EUR 9.33 million) in 2024/2025 vs (EUR 13.12 million) in 2023/2024. Total operating expenses: (EUR 27.56 million) in 2024/2025 vs (EUR 30.27 million) in 2023/2024.

factual_claims.claim: Financial items also produced a smaller net loss, EUR 62 thousand versus EUR 90 thousand previously, although foreign exchange results changed from a gain to a loss.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial items: (EUR 61.86 thousand) in 2024/2025 vs (EUR 89.86 thousand) in 2023/2024. Foreign exchange: (EUR 46.93 thousand) loss in 2024/2025 vs EUR 45.48 thousand gain in 2023/2024.

factual_claims.claim: The fourth quarter was materially weaker.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: The Group closed the fourth quarter of the 2024/2025 financial year with a loss of EUR 913 thousand vs EUR 498 thousand in Q4 of the previous year.

factual_claims.claim: Net sales fell 13% year on year to EUR 5.18 million, and the net loss widened to EUR 913 thousand from EUR 498 thousand.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: The Group’s unaudited consolidated net turnover for Q4 2024/2025 was EUR 5.18 million, representing a 13% decrease. Net loss widened to EUR 913 thousand from EUR 498 thousand.

factual_claims.claim: EBIT deteriorated to a loss of EUR 863 thousand from EUR 495 thousand.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: EBIT for Q4 2024/2025 was (EUR 863.27 thousand) vs (EUR 495.30 thousand) in Q4 2023/2024.

factual_claims.claim: Quarterly turnover was affected by the timing of individual projects, whose production, material procurement and delivery schedules can shift revenue recognition into subsequent quarters.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Fluctuations in quarterly turnover are influenced by the completion of individual projects... dispatch of goods and recognition of revenue often take place only in subsequent quarters.

factual_claims.claim: Regional performance was mixed: North and Latin American turnover declined 40% to EUR 2.5 million, while European turnover increased 24% to EUR 1.9 million and turnover in Asia, Africa and the Middle East doubled to EUR 846 thousand.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: North America and Latin America region turnover decreased by 40% to EUR 2.5 million. European region turnover increased by 24% to EUR 1.9 million. Asia, Africa and Middle East region turnover doubled to EUR 846 thousand.

factual_claims.claim: For the full year, the Americas remained the largest market with EUR 14.28 million of revenue, down 14%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Americas Net Sales for 2024/2025: EUR 14.28 million, down 14% from EUR 16.60 million in 2023/2024.

factual_claims.claim: European revenue rose 17% to EUR 10.04 million, while Asia, Africa and the Middle East declined 5%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Europe, CIS Net Sales increased 17% to EUR 10.04 million. Asia, Africa, Middle East Net Sales declined 5%.

factual_claims.claim: The regional shift toward Europe partly offset the decline in the Americas.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: European revenue increased 17% while Americas revenue declined 14%, indicating a partial offset.

factual_claims.claim: The Group continued investing in new and enhanced products, sales promotion, and IoT solutions; management stated that expenses remained within budget.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: The Group continues to invest in new product development... The Group’s expenses did not exceed the amounts planned in the budget.

factual_claims.claim: Operations continued to be affected by the global shortage of electronic components.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: The Group’s operations were affected by the global shortage of various electronic components.

factual_claims.claim: The Group had accumulated material reserves to meet orders and maintain short delivery times, while component delivery times had recently improved.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: The company accumulated material reserves... Delivery times have continued to improve recently.

factual_claims.claim: Inventories increased 8% to EUR 13.94 million, reflecting the Group’s policy of maintaining materials for timely deliveries and repair services.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Total inventory volumes increased by 8% to EUR 13.94 million. The Group maintains raw materials for timely deliveries and repair services.

factual_claims.claim: Cash generation strengthened considerably.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Net cash flow from operations increased to EUR 2.13 million from EUR 0.94 million.

factual_claims.claim: Net cash flow was EUR 2.60 million, compared with an outflow of EUR 1.25 million in the prior year, and year-end cash increased to EUR 4.81 million from EUR 2.21 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Net cash flow: EUR 2.60 million in 2024/2025 vs outflow of EUR 1.25 million in 2023/2024. Cash and cash equivalents: EUR 4.81 million at end of 2024/2025 vs EUR 2.21 million at end of 2023/2024.

factual_claims.claim: Customer advances were EUR 3.92 million, and the unused EUR 4.95 million Luminor Bank credit line provided additional liquidity capacity.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Advances received from customers: EUR 3.9 million. Credit Line Agreement with Luminor Bank: EUR 4.95 million unused.

factual_claims.claim: Total assets increased to EUR 25.92 million, while owners’ equity declined to EUR 15.58 million, reflecting the year’s loss.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Total assets: EUR 25.92 million. Owners' equity: EUR 15.58 million. Loss of EUR 820 thousand impacted equity.
